title: Some private software companies including McAfee released earnings early to reassure investors worried about an AI-linked selloff, dubbed the "SaaSpocalypse" (Reshmi Basu/Bloomberg)
summary: Reshmi Basu / Bloomberg: Some private software companies including McAfee released earnings early to reassure investors worried about an AI-linked selloff, dubbed the “SaaSpocalypse” — A handful of software firms including McAfee have released their earnings ahead of schedule in a bid to convince lenders …
